title: Week of June 29–July 5
subtitle: Week 3 · Build — ramp bench 165/175/185/190; Squat to 200, Deadlift to 270.
goals: Bench ramp 165/175/185/190 — RPE 8 on the top set (unspotted → keep 1–2 reps left)
Push top sets: Squat → 200, Deadlift → 270, OHP → 120, Incline DB → 130
One hard run Tuesday (Z4); all other runs genuinely easy Z2 — Thursday proved you can do it
Protein ≥180g daily; stay inside the 2200 kcal target
review: Strong Week 2 — lifts moved well across the board. Squat hit 195 (Great), bench exceeded the target at 185 (Good, 1–2 RIR), OHP went to 115, deadlift hit 265 (exceeded 260), incline DB reached 125. Applied your journal note: bench now ramps per-set (165/175/185/190) instead of one flat number. Tuesday’s quality run was excellent — 6×2 min descending 7:30→6:27 pace. Thursday’s easy run was textbook: 3 mi fully Z2 (avg 142). Saturday post-calisthenics jog stayed Z2 (97% — perfect). Weekly run total 12.2 mi, A:C 1.18 — healthy range. Deficit working: 199.5 → 195.9 this week; protein averaged ~200g. Week 3 bumps the key lifts ~5 lb; runs hold at ~13 mi same easy/hard split. Right hip flexor was slightly tight Tuesday — flag if it worsens.

run.detail: Your ONE hard run this week. 10 min easy warm-up, then pick one: (a) 5–6 × 3 min hard / 90s easy jog (step up from 2 min last week), or (b) 20–25 min steady tempo. Check in on the right hip flexor before you open it up — if it’s cranky, back off one gear. 5–10 min easy cool-down.

hr.note: This is the only run you push hard all week. If the hip flexor is more than a 2/10, drop to a tempo run instead of intervals.
